name: Agriculture, veterinary and food
dimension: the stage of the production system

objects.label: Breeding
objects.text: AG.O.A1 Breeding

objects.label: Selection
objects.text: AG.O.A1.1 Selection — the breeder's equation R = h²S predicts response to selection, assuming additive inheritance and a stable environment. The genetics is BI.

objects.label: Genetic improvement
objects.text: AG.O.A1.2 Genetic improvement — hybrids, marker-assisted selection, gene editing. Regulation is LA.

objects.label: Genetic resources
objects.text: AG.O.A1.3 Genetic resources — seed banks, landraces.

objects.label: Cultivation and husbandry
objects.text: AG.O.A2 Cultivation and husbandry

objects.label: Soils and nutrients
objects.text: AG.O.A2.1 Soils and nutrients — fertiliser response. Liebig's law of the minimum holds as a first approximation, when one nutrient limits growth. The soil's state is EA.

objects.label: Water and irrigation
objects.text: AG.O.A2.2 Water and irrigation.

objects.label: Crop management
objects.text: AG.O.A2.3 Crop management — rotation, tillage, sowing. A yield claim must state season, site and population.

objects.label: Animal husbandry
objects.text: AG.O.A2.4 Animal husbandry — pastoral and housed systems, nutrition, welfare. NZ pastoral dairying is a substrate.

objects.label: Aquaculture, fisheries, forestry
objects.text: AG.O.A2.5 Aquaculture, fisheries and forestry production.

objects.label: Crop and animal health
objects.text: AG.O.A3 Crop and animal health

objects.label: Plant protection
objects.text: AG.O.A3.1 Plant protection — pests, weeds, pathogens; integrated pest management.

objects.label: Veterinary medicine
objects.text: AG.O.A3.2 Veterinary medicine — diagnosis and treatment of animal disorders.

objects.label: Biosecurity
objects.text: AG.O.A3.3 Biosecurity — border and incursion management (e.g. Mycoplasma bovis in NZ from 2017, UNVERIFIED date).

objects.label: Zoonoses
objects.text: AG.O.A3.4 Zoonoses — the animal side is AG; human disease is MD (One Health is a bridge).

objects.label: Food
objects.text: AG.O.A4 Food

objects.label: Composition and nutrition
objects.text: AG.O.A4.1 Composition and nutrition — the molecule is CH; human nutritional need is MD.

objects.label: Processing and preservation
objects.text: AG.O.A4.2 Processing and preservation — fermentation, pasteurisation, drying.

objects.label: Food safety
objects.text: AG.O.A4.3 Food safety — HACCP as a control system (W11); pathogen limits.

objects.label: Food standards
objects.text: AG.O.A4.4 Food standards — Codex Alimentarius; FSANZ for Australia and NZ (W12; legal force LA).

objects.label: Farming systems
objects.text: AG.O.A5 Farming systems

objects.label: System productivity
objects.text: AG.O.A5.1 System productivity — total factor productivity of farms (measurement here; economics EC).

objects.label: Farm management
objects.text: AG.O.A5.2 Farm management — decisions under weather and price risk.

objects.label: Environmental effect of farming
objects.text: AG.O.A5.3 Environmental effect of farming — nitrate leaching, methane. The impact claim is EV; AG owns the practice that changes it.

warrants.standard: replicated field trial with stated site and season
controlled trial; surveillance with stated sensitivity
farm data; system model with validation

sections.governing_thought:
Agriculture is exhausted by four faces of one pyramid: objects, methods, warrants and bridges.
Its objects divide into five stages of production: breeding, cultivation and husbandry, crop and animal health, food, and farming systems.
sections.key_line:
Dimension: **the stage of the production system.** Order: from the organism to the whole system.
1. Breeding
2. Cultivation and husbandry
3. Crop and animal health
4. Food
5. Farming systems
sections.assignment_rules:
1. Place by the stage of production.
2. The taxon and its biology are BI. Its production is AG.
3. An animal disorder is AG; a human disorder is MD.
4. The molecule is CH; the food's safety and standard are AG.
5. Farm economics and prices are EC; environmental impact is EV.
